explanation: Brazil beat Italy after a 0-0 draw at the Rose Bowl in Pasadena, California, when Roberto Baggio sent Italy's last kick over the bar. Italy won the next shoot-out final, in 2006.

claims.text: The 1994 men's World Cup final, Brazil against Italy, was the first World Cup final decided by a penalty shoot-out.
The 1978 and 1986 finals were won without a shoot-out, and the 2006 shoot-out final came after 1994.
The 1994 final finished 0-0 after extra time at the Rose Bowl in Pasadena, and Brazil won the shoot-out 3-2.
Roberto Baggio took Italy's last penalty in the 1994 shoot-out and shot over the bar.
Italy beat France on penalties in the 2006 men's World Cup final.
